_comment: All 20 selectable hardships live in this single file. preks intentionally keeps the requested spelling.

debuffs.title: 步履沉重
debuffs.description: 你的每一步都会带有深深的烙印，如果你不穿鞋子，你的移动速度会减少20%，你在移动时，鞋子会持续磨损
debuffs.translated_description: Every step leaves a lasting mark. Without boots, your movement speed is reduced by 20%. Boots lose 1 durability every 10 meters travelled, or every 100 meters for leather boots.

debuffs.title: 梦游症状
debuffs.description: 你经常被梦魇与睡梦折磨，我想你需要好好思考自己的处境，只要连续两晚上不睡觉就会生成幻翼，同时当你从睡梦中醒来，你会发现自己到了陌生的地方
debuffs.translated_description: Nightmares haunt your sleep. Phantoms may appear after two sleepless nights, and waking up teleports you to a random safe open-air location within 200 meters.

debuffs.title: 夜盲症
debuffs.description: 你在黑暗的环境下无法看清任何东西，伸手不见五指的环境令人胆寒，游戏的亮度设置锁定为昏暗，并且在亮度低于2的地方，你将会获得失明
debuffs.translated_description: You cannot see in deep darkness. Brightness is locked to Moody, and you gain Blindness where the light level is below 2.

debuffs.title: 浑身脆骨
debuffs.description: 你的身体显然承受不了任何冲击，你从3格掉下来就会摔伤，你收到的摔落伤害+50%
debuffs.translated_description: Your body cannot withstand impacts. Falling from 3 blocks can hurt you, and fall damage is increased by 50%.

debuffs.title: 久伤难愈
debuffs.description: 你的身体布满了伤痕，每次收到部位受伤效果都会额外获得一层，你的绷带耐久度消耗也会翻倍，同时这会令你的自然生命恢复速度-30%
debuffs.translated_description: Every body-part injury gains one additional level, bandages lose twice as much durability, and natural health regeneration is reduced by 30%.

debuffs.title: 老实人
debuffs.description: 那些邪恶的奸商可不会惯着你，总是会想着狠狠捞一笔，你与村民交易的价格翻倍（不会突破堆叠上限）
debuffs.translated_description: Unscrupulous merchants always take advantage of you. Villager prices are doubled without exceeding item stack limits.

debuffs.title: 洞穴恐惧症
debuffs.description: 洞穴和深坑是你的梦魇，高度低于0的地方会令你的体力恢复速度降低40%，移动速度降低10%
debuffs.translated_description: Caves and deep pits terrify you. Below Y=0, stamina regeneration is reduced by 40% and movement speed by 10%.

debuffs.title: 瘦弱双腿
debuffs.description: 你的双腿可从来不像是强壮的代名词，你在奔跑和跳跃时会消耗体力值，没有体力时你将无法奔跑或跳跃
debuffs.translated_description: Sprinting consumes 4 stamina per second and jumping consumes 10 stamina. You cannot sprint or jump without enough stamina.

debuffs.title: 灾星
debuffs.description: 人常常说你会带来苦难，事实确实如此，妖魔鬼怪经常前来叩响你的家门，敌对生物对你的锁敌范围+80%
debuffs.translated_description: Misfortune follows wherever you go. Hostile mobs can detect and target you from 80% farther away.

debuffs.title: 短手小子
debuffs.description: 你的手从出生起就很短，其他人经常因此取笑你，你与方块的交互距离-1，这不会影响你的攻击与战斗
debuffs.translated_description: Your block interaction range is reduced by 1 block. This does not affect attacks or combat while locked on to a target.

debuffs.title: 二傻子
debuffs.description: 你学任何东西都慢的要命，当同龄人都在附魔时，你什么都不会，因此你的经验获取量-30%
debuffs.translated_description: Learning anything takes you far longer than it should. Experience gained is reduced by 30%.

debuffs.title: 饿死鬼
debuffs.description: 你似乎永远也吃不饱，吃了那么多东西却还是感觉肚子空空，你从食物中获取的饱食度和饱和度减半
debuffs.translated_description: No meal ever feels filling. Food restores only half as much hunger and saturation.

debuffs.title: 手臂孱弱
debuffs.description: 你的手臂无比瘦弱，看起来不像是成为矿工的好苗子，你的挖掘速度降低30%
debuffs.translated_description: Your frail arms are ill suited to mining. Block-breaking speed is reduced by 30%.

debuffs.title: 腰酸背痛
debuffs.description: 每个人的脊椎都有既定的次数，显然你的次数早已超过了限制，当你蹲下的移动速度-30%，且站起来也会保持这个效果1秒
debuffs.translated_description: Sneaking reduces your movement speed by 30%, and the penalty lingers for 1 second after standing up.

debuffs.title: 苦难缠身
debuffs.description: 你曾经有一个护身符，不过你把它给了更需要它的人，这会让你踏入更大的苦难，当你收到攻击时，只要不是完美格挡你就会收到1点真实伤害，无论护甲或者非完美格挡
debuffs.translated_description: Whenever an attack reaches you without being perfectly blocked, you suffer 1 point of true damage regardless of armor or an imperfect guard.

debuffs.title: 体格消瘦
debuffs.description: 从小你就营养不良，穿上沉重的盔甲放大了这种缺陷，你从盔甲中获取的负担负面效果+40%
debuffs.translated_description: A lifetime of poor nutrition makes heavy armor especially burdensome. Armor penalties are increased by 40%.

debuffs.title: 多灾多难
debuffs.description: 神明似乎早就忘记了你的存在，或者是单纯讨厌你，你获得的所有负面效果持续时间+50%
debuffs.translated_description: All harmful vanilla Minecraft status effects applied to you last 50% longer.

debuffs.title: 旱鸭子
debuffs.description: 你从小就不会游泳，自然也不太会憋气，你的游泳速度-30%，氧气消耗+50%
debuffs.translated_description: You never learned to swim or hold your breath properly. Swimming speed is reduced by 30% and oxygen drains 50% faster.

debuffs.title: 大手大脚
debuffs.description: 用起工具时总是大大咧咧，对盔甲的磨损也毫不在意，这会让工具的耐久度消耗翻倍，盔甲的耐久度消耗+50%
debuffs.translated_description: You are rough with tools and careless with armor. Tools lose twice as much durability and armor loses 50% more.

debuffs.title: 血友病
debuffs.description: 每当你收到任何种类的伤害时，你都有50%的概率会获得流血，并且流血的速度翻倍
debuffs.translated_description: Whenever you take any kind of damage, you have a 50% chance to start bleeding. Bleeding deals damage twice as often.
